## Generative AI

This project asks you to say whether AI tools were involved. Either answer is
fine — we route on the disclosure, we do not judge it.

- [ ] I did not use generative AI tools for this change
- [ ] I used generative AI tools, and I have reviewed and understood the result

If you used a coding agent, record it in the commit with
`Assisted-by: <tool>:<model>`. Sign-off, where used, stays human.

## Checks

- [ ] `pytest` passes
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass
- [ ] New behaviour has a test
